response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), avg_per_driver AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers) AS avg_cnt) SELECT c.driverId, c.cnt AS qualifying_count, c.cnt / a.avg_cnt AS ratio_to_average FROM counts c CROSS JOIN avg_per_driver a ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, c.driverId LIMIT 10;
